messages.subject: help:  fvar merge + Eigenization of models/samplers
parts:
(Especially to Michael, Peter and Yuanjun:)

I'm going to work on the following two issues:

master: changing model/sampler data structures to Eigen
vectors

fvar branch: modify models to compute Hessians, gradient
of trace of matrix-Hessian product, etc.,
using forward-mode auto-dif

I'd like to make sure I don't hose anyone else's work in
the process. This will affect anything Michael or Yuanjun
are doing in their own branches with sampling. I don't think
it'll affect what Peter's doing with forward-mode auto-dif,
as that work is all isolated to two files.

Is it OK if I work on the updates in master, then merge
master into fvar? Yuanjun -- you'll have to merge the new
master into your branch, too.

- Bob

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: help:  fvar merge + Eigenization of models/samplers
parts:
On Friday, February 8, 2013 2:16:51 PM UTC-5, Bob Carpenter wrote:
(Especially to Michael, Peter and Yuanjun:)

I'm going to work on the following two issues:

   master:  changing model/sampler data structures to Eigen
            vectors

   fvar branch: modify models to compute Hessians, gradient
                of trace of matrix-Hessian product, etc.,
                using forward-mode auto-dif

I'd like to make sure I don't hose anyone else's work in
the process.

In principal, it is impossible to lose data in git. You could create merge conflicts, but those are arguably a good problem (two people have made mutually exclusive changes to the same line) and easily resolved.

Is it OK if I work on the updates in master, then merge
master into fvar?  Yuanjun -- you'll have to merge the new
master into your branch, too.

Someone should be merging master into remote branches at fairly regular intervals anyway. I don't think there is a technical problem with modifying master in anticipation of fvar being (re)merged eventually (as long as the code is not actually being called until fvar has been incorporated). But neither would there be a technical problem with modifying fvar and merging the whole thing into master whenever it is ready.

Ben
